# Response to RFQ VPK-2026-014 — Technical maintenance, warehouse and logistics properties

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification for HVAC and electrical contracting. Our liability insurance cover is EUR 2,000,000, against the required threshold of EUR 1,000,000 under Section 3.2.

## Technical response

**Occupational safety plan.** A site-specific occupational safety plan is enclosed, maintained under our NMSB 75310:2018 system, and covers the particular hazards of warehouse and logistics environments — vehicle movement, racking, and confined plant rooms.

**Condition-monitoring data.** Measurements taken at each visit are logged and reported to the buyer in a standard format, so trends in equipment condition are visible across the contract term rather than only at the point of failure.

**Environmental matters.** Managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system, covering waste segregation, handling of hazardous substances and spill prevention.

**Quality control and testing.** Delivered under our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, with each visit checked off against a standard work instruction for the relevant system.

**Preventive maintenance plan.** A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for the systems covered by this contract, sequencing servicing ahead of known wear points rather than waiting for a fault report.

**HVAC maintenance agreement.** Our proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, cleaning and performance checks across all three sites, with the scope set out per site in the enclosed schedule.

**Personnel qualifications.** Personnel working on site hold the occupational cards and trade certificates the work requires, drawn from our own workforce of 62 LVI and 48 sahko specialists, so cover does not depend on subcontracted labour for routine work.

**Building automation compatibility.** Compatible with BACnet/Modbus building automation systems, allowing our monitoring to integrate directly with the buyer's existing platform.

**Routine maintenance visits.** A fixed visit calendar is proposed for all three sites, with the standard scope of tasks confirmed at each visit.

**Service-level targets.** SLA targets are proposed for each site, set against response time and completion time separately.

## Commercial terms

The proposed contract period follows Section 1, with the extension option accepted. Our proposed limitation-of-liability clause reflects our professional indemnity cover of EUR 1,000,000. A bonus/malus arrangement is proposed against the service levels above, applied quarterly. Pricing structure: fixed price per site, reviewed annually against the agreed index.

## Forms enclosed

List of subcontractors (Liite 3); completed Reference Form (Liite 2).

## Format

Reference currency is EUR. This document does not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices. Unit basis for pricing is per property. Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not on a monthly basis.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Lift maintenance is carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection requirements. Energy-efficiency measures are monitored and reported at each of the three sites. Fault reports outside normal working hours are covered by our standby (on-call) arrangement, with a defined response-time commitment.

## Annex B — Forms and commercial terms

Subcontractor costs are itemised and made transparent to the buyer, with any mark-up disclosed. A current trade register extract is enclosed. Completed Tender Form (Liite 1).

Visakoivu Oy
